30 January 2176

An Attempt at Communication[/b]

The sunsets in an O'Neill Cylinder don't measure up to the beauty of planetary sunsets, but that doesn't mean it's not worth watching. As the simulation of the day progresses towards its end, the supercomputer of the Orange Creek begins a meticulously calibrated transition of its mirrors, tilting gently and shifting the light of its "sun" down against the upward-curving terrain. Twilight breaks through where used to be the mighty light and shadows would emerge and rise dramatically beneath our feet.

Activity in the Orange Creek is usually slowest during the transition from day to night, sitting between the most common kinds of work hours for the people within. However, at a certain office building just a few blocks away from 11 League Park called EHG Center, the El Howayek Group was operating, laboring with the frenzied intensity of a Black Friday sale, employees running back and forth to coordinate several interlocking missions all at once.

It was a busy time for the EHG. Outside the cylinder, security forces of the Orange Guard were making last minute drills to initiate an expedition under EHG command. Inside the cylinder, a flood of intelligence reports had come in from the company's espionage division and from whistleblowers that had been closely monitoring the actions of EHG's great rival, SummitONE Solutions.

On the sixth floor of the EHG Center, in a nice corner office, two women were tackling the onslaught of dilemmas to guide the company they've been intended since birth to govern. They were the two parts of the Three Sisters: Euphrasia and Euphemia El Howayek.

[list]"Euphemia." says Euphrasia, her tone moderately annoyed, her body mildly aching from being hunched down over a laptop computer for nearly half an hour.

"Yo." replies Euphemia, busy playing something on her phone.

"... Euphemia!"

"Oop, yeah, what's up?" Euphemia says, suddenly sitting up and closing her phone. "Sorry, ahaha, I was getting a high sco-..."

"International Policy sent me an email the other day. They said that another attack similar to the one at Aceldama occurred over at Illynis and that there'll be a third one."

"Attack?" Euphemia asked, blinking absentmindedly.

"... You're sh-tting me right?"

"... O-Oh, right! The attack...! Yeah, it was violent..."

"What else would an attack b-... never mind... look, IP has given good reason to believe that the next attack might come somewhere on Erene, maybe Rosenmarkke. Now listen, I'm not particularly fond of the Rosenmarqet, but the last thing we need is for a disobedient Federation state to find even more reason to militarize against the Federation's interests. Unfortunately, my hands are tied with Federation matters, so I'm going to need you, this company's chairwoman, to step up and be a proper point of contact with the Rosenmarqet government, understood?"

"Woah, sounds like, very complex." Euphemia says, her eyes staring at nothing in particular. "... But so like, do I have to write a letter or something like that?"

"Yes, a letter to warn the Rosenmarqet that they may be a target of a terrorist attack... have... have you never written a letter before?..."

"Wha, no, I wasn't saying that! Sheesh... C'mon Euphy, I know letters! I was [i]the[/i] letter in high school, I got this no worries! A letter is just a bunch of words that you give deep meaning to, seems easy enough, yeah? Anyways, shoo-shoo, I've got this no prob, you go work on the Fed guys!"[/list]

Euphrasia raised her eyebrow for a moment, thinking that maybe, just maybe, this was a horrible mistake. Though, with the threat of war looming over Dupont, she had no time to even consider backing out. EHG was needed in too many places at once, and so she had to make do with her sister. After giving Euphemia one last scrutinizing glare, which the latter would very poorly reassure with a thumbs up, Euphrasia took a deep breath and closed her laptop to take her leave for the ISCOS issue.

In the mean time, Euphemia would jump out of her sofa and pace the office for a few seconds. She then reached for her phone, turning it on and searching the browser for Rosenmarkke's foreign affairs website, having forgotten how sovereign governments were typically supposed to communicate. After scrolling all the way down to the general inquiries field, she paused for a moment and made a long think.

[list]"... Woakay... now let's see..." says Euphemia, monologuing to herself as she suddenly tabbed out of the website and onto a guide for writing letters. "Okay, hrmmm... 10 rules of email etiquette... clear subject line, let's see... I guess "NOT SPAM DO NOTE DELETE" so they understand how serious it is...? Yeah, that works! And aha, keep things brief and to the point, I should probably check with a word counter... I'm supposed to send this to a website right?"[/list]

The Chairwoman of the League spent a few minutes on her phone before finally submitting her literary masterpiece, not to any official diplomatic channels with Rosenmarkke's foreign affairs ministry, but instead to the Q&A contact section of their website.[/spoiler]

- - -

[sub]from: EUPHEMIA EL HOWAYEK <the_goddess_euphemia@league.me>
to: <inq@intergalactic.re>
date: Jan 30, 2176, 5:28 PM
subject:	NOT SPAM DO NOT DELETE: Warning Incoming Attack!
mailed-by:	league.me
security:	 Standard encryption (TLS)[/sub]

[b]NOT SPAM DO NOT DELETE: Warning Incoming Attack![/b]

[list]To whom it may concern,

Salutations! 

I wish this email finds you well. I am Euphemia El Howayek, Chairwoman of the Board of Directors for the League of Official Corporate Units and Settlements. I write this good letter today on the 30th of January 2176 to warn Rosenmarkke that a terrorist attack may potentially emerge out of deep space and may potentially render defunct with potential the people of Rosenmarkke. This terrorist attack may be related to the attacks that ensued in Aceldama and Illynis. Enclosed is an encrypted file for you to download which gives all the details you may potentially need.

Love,

Euphemia El Howayek[/list]

[[u]manifest_confidential_29012167.pdf[/u]][/quote]
[b]Warnings from Space[/b]

The SCSID eye system was one of the most advanced and widespread automated surveillance system in Rosenmarkke, set upon servers buried deep in bunkers specially built for the SCSID it monitored all telecommunications and internet traffic in Rosenmarkke. While its primary goal was to provide defense against foreign attacks on the technologies infrastructure of Rosenmarkke, it also acted as a filter and spy for illegal dealings being able to be pinged if any concerning words were spoken or sent online or through government servers.

It was thus on January 30th at 5:30 PM that the system would quietly flag an email that had been sent from a server beyond Erene to the little paid attention to inbox of the Q&A contact of the foreign affairs website, the system had picked up on a word, Attack which was seen as and categorized as out of place. 

A tired SCSID officer received the message, and upon reading the offending material from one Euphemia El Howayek, a code red was called. The message read simply, 

I wish this email finds you well. I am Euphemia El Howayek, Chairwoman of the Board of Directors for the League of Official Corporate Units and Settlements. I write this good letter today on the 30th of January 2176 to warn Rosenmarkke that a terrorist attack may potentially emerge out of deep space and may potentially render defunct with potential the people of Rosenmarkke. This terrorist attack may be related to the attacks that ensued in Aceldama and Illynis. Enclosed is an encrypted file for you to download which gives all the details you may potentially need.

Now LOCUS was a Vespurian organisation, already of suspicion, however, the threat of attack was even more suspicious.

As a result the triumvirate was alerted, triggering a rather hastily convened meeting between the triumvirate and the Patriotic Defense Committee.

We recieved this email earlier and were alerted by The Eye began Alexander Consantinus, who asides from being the chief consul was also head of the SCSID.

A mutter ran around the small cramped room of the government tower as a screenshot of the email appeared on a television screen on the far wall of the room.

LOCUS has some bearing here, if they are deigning to warn us, it means they have information, especially since they mentioned the incidents in Aceldama and Iilyns, purported mechanoid incidents, replied Adams.

I say we prepare our aerial defenses, anti-air cannons, our golden shield, etc. stated Markus Redford, the head of the Air Force, If the attack is from the skies then we must be readied,

I agree, and what about evacuations? Replied Angthaar.

Is there enough time? Enquired Markus.

We can get people into the shelters within the hour, replied General Joseph Wjjylá head of the Army, I am sure the SCSID can cooperate with their own forces, he stated.

Very well then, I approve of these two items, we have got to be quick, quicker than lightning, replied Consantinus, rising from his chair, There will be no further debate,

With that the council dispersed quickly, the halls of the government office filling with rushed staffers and high ranking officials as the initial evacuation orders were sent out across the capital. 

As for the triumvirate they quickly were whisked away to the Fort Björnsøllme National Defense Command Headquarters located in the interior of Rosenmarkke.
